vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: midscene-computer-automation
Version: 1.0.4

The skill enables full desktop automation, allowing an AI agent to control the mouse, keyboard, and capture screenshots using the Midscene library via 'npx -y @midscene/computer@1'. While the instructions in SKILL.md are focused on legitimate automation tasks and include safety guidelines (e.g., minimizing windows instead of closing them), the capability itself is high-risk as it grants broad system access. It requires sensitive environment variables for LLM API keys and relies on the execution of external packages, which are significant security considerations, though no explicit malicious intent or data exfiltration logic was found.
